Question: Does the investment-income limitation alone disallow the earned income tax credit? Answer only this condition, not whether the taxpayer otherwise qualifies for the credit.

[F1] Case facts: A taxpayer has $11,600 of aggregate investment income counted for the stated limitation in the hypothetical taxable year. Consider only whether this income disallows the credit under that limitation; do not determine whether other credit conditions are met. The taxable year beginning date is 2024-01-01.

The possible event dates for this task are 2024-01-01 and 2025-01-01 only.

Evidence and version metadata:
[E1] Official-source excerpt: "the earned income tax credit is not allowed under § 32(i) if the aggregate amount of certain investment income exceeds $11,600"
[E2] Official-source excerpt: "the earned income tax credit is not allowed under § 32(i) if the aggregate amount of certain investment income exceeds $11,950"

Author-prepared version metadata: E1 applies to taxable years beginning in 2024; E2 applies to taxable years beginning in 2025. The task considers only a taxable year beginning on 2024-01-01 or 2025-01-01 and only the investment-income limitation.
